White-marked rows are the other editor's, red-marked rows are already edited — we only do the UNMARKED rows. Work one mic part at a time (current_mic), first 'todo' in board order within it; when a mic part has no todo left, move to the next mic part that has one. Update this file (status, version, export) in the same commit as the job. n/mic refer to mic_map.json.
